raw_text: Al-Qassam Brigades announces Operation Al-Aqsa Flood. Thousands of rockets fired at Israeli cities from Gaza Strip. Fighters have breached the border fence at multiple points in the Gaza envelope. Ground operations underway in settlements near the border. This is the largest military operation from Gaza in the history of the conflict.
